run_rtsp_server_from_video_directory: run the RTSP server to stream video files from a given directory using ffmpeg
create_server_config_file: create an RTSP server YAML configuration file in a temporary directory
find_video_files_in_directory: find video files in a directory matching mp4 and webm formats with a limit
stream_videos_to_rtsp_urls: stream multiple video files concurrently to RTSP URLs using background threads
stream_video_to_url: stream a single video file to an RTSP URL using ffmpeg in a background thread
